svg.aria-label: Snapshot 4 to 10 s: A and B both C4 + E4, major third, 4 semitones. Snapshot 14 to 20 s: A C4 + F4, perfect fourth, 5 semitones; B B3 + F4, diminished fifth, 6 semitones. Snapshot 26 to 32 s: both C4 + E4 again.
svg.title: Three snapshots: what stayed, what changed

g.text: How to read this graphic: Read each column as
one moment. The two badges in a column are
the pair in Version A and the pair in Version
B at that moment. Compare across the row:
same, different, same. The middle column also
